# ECOFLOT

ECOFLOT provides waste removal and container services in Moscow, Odintsovo and the Moscow Region.

## Main services
- Waste removal in Odintsovo: https://ecoflot.pro/vyvoz-musora-odincovo/
- Waste removal in Moscow: https://ecoflot.pro/vyvoz-musora-moskva/
- Construction waste removal: https://ecoflot.pro/vyvoz-stroitelnogo-musora/
- Waste removal after renovation: https://ecoflot.pro/vyvoz-musora-posle-remonta/
- Bulky waste removal: https://ecoflot.pro/vyvoz-krupnogabaritnogo-musora/
- Waste removal by Gazelle: https://ecoflot.pro/vyvoz-musora-gazelyu/
- Container rental: https://ecoflot.pro/arenda-konteynera/
- 8 m3 container: https://ecoflot.pro/konteyner-8m3/
- 20 and 27 m3 containers: https://ecoflot.pro/konteynery-20-27m3/
- Container for construction waste: https://ecoflot.pro/konteyner-dlya-stroitelnogo-musora/
- Waste removal for business: https://ecoflot.pro/vyvoz-musora-dlya-biznesa/
- Prices: https://ecoflot.pro/ceny/
